Gravity infusion, also known as 'the drip' is one of the most commonly used methods for delivering essential drugs, basic fluids and nutritional therapy to patients in the healthcare setting. Correct application and calculation of an infusion drip-rate is essential for patient safety and effective therapeutic treatment.

ivDripRate is an application that has been developed for managing gravity infusion. It has features to help you calculate, set and check infusion drip-rates. 

FEATURES
* Calculate infusions (drip-rate and flow rate).
* Set up an infusion using the drip visualisation, sync the rate with with the real drip.
* Check the drip-rate of a set infusion.
* Enable vibration and sound for the 'set' and 'check' features.
* Screen capture each of your calculations and workings by pressing the 'power' button and 'home' button on the iPhone simultaneously.

To get started, you will need:

The experience 
Follow an easy, guided experience in the app with on-screen video prompts, as well as audio instructions.  
Sync the app with a computer, then scan your prescribed glasses with your mobile phone’s camera. 
In just a few minutes, you will receive your prescription details.  
  
myRx Lens Scanner is a good fit for those who: 
-Are healthy individuals, 18 years or older 
-Have no concerns about your eye health 
-Have stable vision and are happy with your current prescription 
-Have single vision glasses parameters between -6.00 and +3.00 with the cylinder measurement lower than -2.50 
 
myRx Lens Scanner isn’t suitable for those who: 
-Have multifocal, bifocal, progressive lenses 
-Have a prescription that includes a prism measurement 
-Have a high single-vision distance, reading, and/or astigmatism power 
-Take any medication that affects your vision 
-Have any illness or condition that affects ocular health 
  
How accurate are the results? 
myRx Lens Scanner is FDA and CE Listed. The results have been tested and proven to be as accurate as the standard acceptable for lensometers and PD meters. 
 
myRx Lens Scanner is a registered Class 1 Exempt Medical Device on the FDA Medical Device Listings and CE (EU) self-declared Class 1.  
Please note: myRx Lens Scanner does not provide medical advice and does not replace a comprehensive eye health exam. We encourage you to visit your eye doctor regularly.  
The results provided by myRx Lens Scanner are not a signed prescription.

Wisely é uma ferramenta de apoio à decisão clínica para ajudar os médicos na solicitação de exames de imagem de forma prática e rápida. Nossas sugestoes são baseadas em evidências cientificas atualizadas e endossadas por diversas associações médicas internacionais. O objetivo do aplicativo é melhorar desfechos clínicos priorizando as modalidades de imagem mais adequadas para cada situação clínica, além de evitar exames de imagem desnecessários.  

Como utilizar:
1.	Escolha a região anatômica relacionado ao sintoma do seu paciente.
2.	Selecione o sintoma ou diagnóstico mais compatível com a situação clínica.
3.	Decida qual variante clínica se encaixa melhor na apresentação do seu paciente.
4.	Pronto, você terá o resultado de quais modalidades de imagem são mais adequadas para seu paciente.

Os métodos de imagem são agrupados em três categorias:
1.	Apropriado - em que os benefícios do procedimento ou tratamento ultrapassam os riscos dos mesmos;
2.	Eventualmente apropriado - procedimentos em que os benefícios são equívocos
3.	Inapropriado - em que os danos do procedimento não ultrapassam os benefícios
